fidelityReview.notes: Passed for the permanent detailed world-viewer exterior reconstruction. Official Persian tourism dimensions establish twelve ribs, ten entrance columns, 4.10 m column height, 0.95/0.75 m base/top diameters, 23 m tower above roof, 2.05 m cone radius and 3.4 m cone height. The national-heritage plan, architect archive and current official photographs establish rib cross sections, narrow circular cap, rough granite, raised clerestory platform, colonnade and rooftop marker. The extended base follows mapped museum geometry; stair grades, ramp landings, roof planting boundaries, lightwell widths and individual masonry are explicitly proportional reconstructions. The 28.5 m architectural composition sets tower height; it is not misused to shrink the whole connected museum footprint. Interior exhibits and exact inscription glyphs are outside the exterior asset.
